name: mobisys-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for ACM MobiSys submissions: mobile-systems topic fit, HotCRP submission audit, the two-round + rebuttal response, ACM-badge artifact evaluation, on-device reproducibility, supplementary packaging, review-process modeling, 12-page writing, related-work coverage, real-device experiments, workflow, and sibling routing. Grounded in the official MobiSys 2027 CFP (single-blind review) and organizing-committee pages on sigmobile.org, the mobisys27.hotcrp.com deadlines, the MobiSys 2026 artifact-evaluation call, ACM Digital Library, and dblp, re-verified 2026-11-24.
